title: The Ugly Duckling
moral: Everyone grows in their own way and in their own time; being different is nothing to be ashamed of, and kindness to someone who feels different can help them find where they belong.
how_to: Every prompt in prompt_manifest.json is a template rendered from this file by production/image_prompts.py --story ugly_duckling_v1 (build, lint, show, md, review). Character identities are design specs until each canonical image is approved; then rewrite them from the image (hex sampled from it) and rebuild.

swans.name: the Swans
swans.identity: Each adult swan of the swan family is identical: a large handcrafted wool-felt swan with a softly rounded warm ivory-white body (#F4F1EA), gentle pearl-grey shading beneath the folded wings (#DCDAD3), a long curved neck and rounded head. The broad coral-orange bill (#E2784A) has a dark charcoal base and rounded knob (#292725); two charcoal webbed feet (#4A4946), two glossy dark-brown eyes (#3E2A1E) with black pupils, ivory sclera and white catchlights, two short brown eyebrow stitches, two layered folded wings and one short pointed tail. With its neck up, each adult swan is slightly taller than Ollie the swan. Fine looped felt fibres and visible stitching. Keep these identity colours and mid-brightness stable; scene lighting may tint them consistently with the background. Pose, facing and expression follow each prompt.
swans.sheet: a large warm ivory-white wool-felt swan with a long curved neck, coral-orange bill with dark knob, folded wings and charcoal webbed feet
swans.short: the Swans is a large warm ivory-white wool-felt swan with a long curved neck, coral-orange bill with dark knob, folded wings and charcoal webbed feet.
swans.mouth: When a swan speaks, its beak opens slightly to show a soft pink inside.
checklist: coral-orange beak with a black knob

ollie_swan.name: Ollie the swan
ollie_swan.identity: Ollie the swan is one young wool-felt swan, the grown-up form of Ollie: a softly rounded warm ivory-white body (#F4F1EA), subtle pearl-grey shading beneath the layered folded wings (#DCDAD3), a long curved neck, a rounded head and a short pointed tail. His coral-orange bill (#E2784A) has a dark charcoal knob and base (#292725); two charcoal webbed feet (#4A4946). He has two glossy dark-brown eyes (#3E2A1E) with black pupils, ivory sclera and white catchlights, small dark patches beside the bill and two soft grey-brown eyebrow stitches. Fine looped felt fibres and visible feather stitching. With his neck up he is about 1.9 times Mama Duck’s height. Keep identity colours and mid-brightness stable; scene lighting may tint them consistently with the background. Pose, facing and expression follow each prompt.

ollie_swan.short: Ollie the swan is one young warm ivory-white wool-felt swan with a long curved neck, coral-orange bill with dark knob, folded layered wings and charcoal webbed feet.

ottie.name: Ottie
ottie.identity: Ottie is one cheerful upright wool-felt river otter with a round head, compact body and a long thick tail curled to one side. Her fur is warm medium chocolate-brown (#875A3E), with a cream-beige muzzle, throat and oval chest (#E2C39E). She has two small round ears, a broad muzzle, a large dark-brown nose (#493024), a stitched smiling mouth, four fine pale whiskers on each side, two glossy dark-brown eyes (#3E2A1E) with white catchlights and two short brown brow stitches. Her short forearms meet at her chest; she has two hind feet and one long tapering tail. Fine looped felt fibres and visible stitches. Upright, she is slightly taller than Mama Duck. Keep identity colours and mid-brightness stable; scene lighting may tint them consistently with the background. Pose and expression follow each prompt.

ottie.short: Ottie is one upright chocolate-brown wool-felt otter with cream muzzle and chest, round dark nose, pale whiskers and a long curled tail.
ottie.mouth: When Ottie's mouth opens, it is a rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior, a soft pink tongue and small ivory teeth.
checklist: one otter, four legs, one long thick tail

mama.name: Mama Duck
mama.identity: Mama Duck is one plump, gentle wool-felt mother duck standing on two orange webbed feet. Her softly rounded body and head are warm medium brown (#9C6844), with buff-cream feather speckles (#E3C9A0), a pale cream chest (#EADBBE) and thin cream markings above her eyes. Her broad flat bill and feet are golden orange (#EBA13A). Two glossy dark-brown eyes (#3E2A1E) have black pupils, ivory sclera and white catchlights; two short dark-brown brow stitches sit above them. Her two folded wings have layered feather stitching and each has one deep teal-blue patch (#247783) edged in cream; one short pointed feather tail. Fine looped felt fibres and visible stitches. Keep identity colours and mid-brightness stable; scene lighting may tint them consistently with the background. Pose, facing and expression follow each prompt.

mama.short: Mama Duck is one plump warm-brown felt mother duck with cream speckles and chest, golden-orange bill and feet, and teal patches on folded wings.
mama.mouth: When Mama Duck speaks, her flat beak opens slightly to show a soft pink inside; she has no teeth.
checklist: one duck, two wings, two webbed feet, one short tail

ollie.name: Ollie
ollie.identity: Ollie is one young wool-felt cygnet with a large softly rounded head, a slightly long neck and a fluffy, compact body. His dove-grey down is a warm grey (#9A928B), with lighter pale-grey cheeks and chest (#C9C3BB). He has a flat slate-grey bill (#77716C) with a darker rounded tip, two long charcoal-grey legs and two broad flat webbed feet (#4A4946), two small folded fluffy wings and a short fluffy tail. Two large glossy dark-brown eyes (#3E2A1E) have black pupils, ivory sclera and white catchlights; two short grey-brown brow stitches. Fine looped felt fibres and visible stitching. He is about 0.55 times Mama Duck’s height. Keep identity colours and mid-brightness stable; scene lighting may tint them consistently with the background. Pose, facing and expression follow each prompt.

ducklings.name: the Ducklings
ducklings.identity: Each of the three ducklings is identical: one small, round, fluffy wool-felt duckling with bright golden buttercup-yellow down (#F5D04A) and a slightly paler lemon-yellow chest (#F8E27C). Each has a small flat orange bill (#EE9A3A), two tiny orange webbed feet, two stubby wings, two glossy dark-brown eyes (#3E2A1E) with black pupils, ivory sclera and white catchlights, and two short brown brow stitches. Fine looped felt fibres and visible stitching. Each duckling is about one third of Mama Duck’s height. Keep identity colours and mid-brightness stable; scene lighting may tint them consistently with the background. Pose, facing and expression follow each prompt.

blocks.style: Style: handcrafted wool-felt stop-motion storybook miniature; softly stuffed matte forms, tactile looped wool fibres, fine visible stitching and gentle handmade irregularities; warm child-friendly palette and soft directional light; clear subject silhouettes; faces and contact points sharply readable.
blocks.runtime_style: Handcrafted matte wool-felt stop-motion miniature, tactile fibres and stitching, softly lit, sharp readable subjects.
blocks.light_and_colour: Light and colour: every character keeps exactly the colours, saturation and brightness of its canonical image; the scene light may only tint it the same way it tints the background, with the same exposure and contrast as the background. Characters are lit from the same direction as the plate and cast soft contact shadows on its ground, so they sit in the scene rather than on top of it.
blocks.final_check: Before finishing, check: each named character appears exactly once and every group has exactly the number the cast line states; every bird has exactly two eyes, one beak, two wings and two webbed feet, Ottie has four limbs and one tail, and every character has two eyebrow stitches, one above each eye; no text, letters, labels or watermark anywhere.
blocks.edit_end_frame: This is an edit of the accepted start frame of this shot (the first attached reference): keep its camera, crop, background, light and every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position exactly; change only what this frame shows below.
blocks.edit_reference: Edit the first attached reference, the approved parent image: keep the character's identity, colours, brightness and proportions exactly; change only the view or pose stated here.
blocks.edit_expression: Edit the first attached reference, the approved closed-mouth portrait: keep its crop, head size and position, every feature, colour, the felt texture, the whiskers, the backdrop and the light exactly; change only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth.
blocks.studio_full_body: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop, soft even neutral light and a small soft contact shadow under the feet; the whole body, ears, paws, mane where present and the single tail inside the frame with about 8% margin on every side.
blocks.studio_portrait: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, with no room, furniture, floor or horizon, and soft even neutral light; head-and-shoulders crop with the whole head, both ears and any mane inside the frame with a small margin; the head keeps the size and eye-line of the approved closed-mouth portrait.
blocks.plate_rules: Empty plate: no characters and no story props. Normal-height camera, the whole scene edge to edge, open in-focus ground where characters will stand, distant background slightly soft. Every landmark keeps the position stated above; a different light state of this place reuses exactly the same geometry.
blocks.cast_scale: Relative size (fixed for the whole story, the same at the same distance from the camera), with Mama Duck's height as 1: each yellow duckling 0.35, Ollie the grey cygnet 0.55, Ottie standing upright 1.1, Ollie the grown swan with his neck up 1.9, each adult swan 2.1. The cygnet Ollie is clearly bigger than the yellow ducklings and clearly smaller than Mama Duck. Swimming, sitting or curling up changes a silhouette but never the size of a head, beak or wing.
blocks.studio_lineup: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, soft even neutral light, one flat ground line at y=0.88 where every character stands, with a small soft contact shadow under each; every whole body, every ear tip, foot and tail inside the frame with a margin.
blocks.edit_open_mouth: This is an edit of the accepted closed-mouth start frame of this shot (the first attached reference): keep its camera, crop, background, light and the character's identity, colours, brightness, size, pose, head position and gaze exactly; open only the mouth into the approved rounded speech shape shown in the attached mouth-design reference, with the same interior and any teeth as in that reference. This is the single open-mouth key frame the talking clip animates to, so the open shape stays identical to the character's approved speech mouth.
blocks.studio_water_reference: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop edge to edge, soft even neutral light. A minimal hint of still water touches only the bottom of the frame around Ollie’s floating lower body; show a small soft waterline and a few subtle ripples. No land, shoreline, rocks, scenery, props, sky, floor, horizon or foot-ground contact shadow. Keep Ollie’s full neck, head, bill, wings, back and tail inside the square with clear backdrop around them; his lower body and feet may be naturally at or below the low waterline.
blocks.light_and_colour_water: Light and colour: Ollie keeps exactly the colours, saturation, brightness and exposure of his approved canonical image; the soft studio light remains even and neutral. The small water hint receives the same light as the backdrop and creates only subtle water contact ripples, with no ground shadow.

reference_roles.edit_base: the edit base ({what}): keep everything in it (camera, crop, background, light, every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position) except what this prompt changes
reference_roles.identity_root: {who}'s approved canonical image: copy {who}'s identity exactly, with the same shapes, proportions, colours and brightness
reference_roles.locked_plate: the locked location plate ({what}): reproduce this background exactly, with the same landmarks, light and camera
reference_roles.world_state: the previous accepted frame ({what}): carry over the world state (props, damage, contacts and positions) unless this prompt changes it; use the framing stated in this prompt
reference_roles.camera_geometry: camera and layout reference ({what}): copy only the camera position and the layout of the place; take no character or prop state from it
reference_roles.expression: expression reference ({what}): copy only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth shape onto {who}'s canonical face
reference_roles.pose: pose reference ({what}): copy only {who}'s body pose and proportions, not the background
reference_roles.prop: prop reference ({what}): copy the prop's material, colour, shape and size; its state in this frame is the one stated in this prompt
reference_roles.mouth_design: mouth design reference ({what}): copy only the mouth opening, the teeth and their size
reference_roles.staging_only: staging reference ({what}): copy only the character positions, relative sizes and composition; use the locked plate for all background geometry, and use the canonical images for identity
reference_roles.size_anchor: size anchor ({what}): an approved frame of this same camera setup; every character keeps exactly the size it has there, and takes no pose, expression or prop state from it
reference_roles.framing: framing reference ({what}): copy only the shot size, where the head sits in the frame and how strongly the background is blurred; take no character, background, light or expression from it
reference_roles.size_lineup: the story's size lineup ({what}): copy only the size relation between Leo and Milo, applied at the sizes stated in this prompt; take no camera, background, pose, expression or prop state from it
reference_roles.character_guide_board: the labeled character guide board ({what}): use the panel labelled canonical for identity and the named expression and pose panels only for those features; do not copy the board layout or labels
